bio.text: Brian Fitzpatrick represents Pennsylvania's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House and sits on the Ways and Means and Intelligence committees.
Before entering public office he spent 15 years as an FBI Special Agent and federal prosecutor, including a period embedded with U.S. Special Forces during Operation Iraqi Freedom.
He holds a JD and an MBA from Penn State University and was born and raised in Levittown, Bucks County.
